articles.title: Iran hasn't tried to repair nuclear facilities damaged in US strikes, UN nuclear chief says
articles.description: The head of the UN nuclear agency said Tuesday there has been no indication Iran has tried to repair or reconstruct its nuclear facilities damaged in US and Israeli military strikes this year or last year.
